Decoration pricing

Price a decoration on its own: prints by size (DTF / DTG), embroidery by stitch count (primary + additional logos), screen print by ink colors (front + back locations). Every part — blank + each piece, rounded to $0.50 — so the shirt price adds up by hand. (A different model than the live tools, under evaluation.)

⚗ Experiment to evaluate the “blank + decoration line items” model for DTF, DTG, embroidery, and screen print. Not linked anywhere, changes no live tool, and every part is rounded to $0.50 so the price adds up by hand.
